title: Northbeam TechWorks Fee Ledger Reading: Fees Carried on a Business Invoice
content:
Which fees on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job a business invoice settlement covers is read from the kinds of fee standing on the job.

**Where fees stand on the job both for moving the slot and for the distance travelled**, every fee standing on the job is covered.

**Where a fee stands on the job for the distance travelled and none for moving the slot**, the fees booked for the day the crew was dispatched are covered.

**Where neither situation holds**, the fees the settlement covers are the fees booked for the day the job was completed.

## The readings side by side

| A fee for moving the slot stands on the job | A fee for the distance travelled stands on the job | The fees covered |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | every fee standing on the job, of whatever kind |
| no | yes | the fees booked for the day the crew was dispatched |
| yes | no | the fees booked for the day the job was completed |
| no | no | the fees booked for the day the job was completed |

The first two readings turn on a fee for the distance travelled standing on the job at all; a job carrying a slot-move fee but no distance charge falls to the third reading.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**A slot-move fee and no distance charge.** The third reading governs, and only the fees booked for the day the job was completed are covered.

**A distance charge and no slot-move fee.** A hypothetical job carries a distance charge of 52.80 USD and a crew attendance charge of 69.00 USD booked for the day the crew was dispatched, and a diagnostic charge of 112.00 USD booked for an earlier day. The second reading governs and 121.80 USD is covered.

**Both kinds standing.** The same job also carries a slot-move fee of 58.00 USD. Every fee standing on the job is now covered: 291.80 USD.
